title: Packet retention: admit one capture per (delegation, attempt, identity) under overlapping parent packet reads
outcome: Overlapping parent packet reads of a terminal reviewer run at most one failing capture per record identity, not one each.
acceptance: When two parent packet reads overlap on the same terminal attempt and record identity, at most one runs a capture; the other makes no custody write and serves either nothing new or the shared outcome. Shown by a deterministic overlap test, using a hook between the packet's discovery check and the owner guard, not timing.
No lock is held across capture I/O, and an abandoned or panicking capture cannot block later retries.
